frontmatter.title: Bespoke OLAP: Using AI to Synthesize Workload-Specific Database Engines from Scratch
frontmatter.author: Johannes Wehrstein, Timo Eckmann, Matthias Jasny, Carsten Binnig, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: Every modern OLAP engine pays a hidden performance tax: the cost of being general-purpose. What if we could let AI build a database engine for exactly your workload, from scratch, in a few hours? We introduce Bespoke OLAP, a fully autonomous synthesis pipeline that uses LLM-guided code generation to produce complete, workload-specific C++ database engines, achieving 11.78x total speedup over DuckDB on TPC-H.
